title: Power identity for the Gowers norm
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $k$ be a positive integer, and let $f\colon\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$. Define $\|f\|_{U^k}$ as the $2^k$-th root of $\mathbb E_{x,y_1,\ldots,y_k}\prod_{s\in\mathbb F_2^k}f(x+\sum_{i=1}^k s_i y_i)$, with the average uniform over $x,y_1,\ldots,y_k\in\mathbb F_2^n$. Then $\|f\|_{U^k}^{2^k}=\mathbb E_{x,y_1,\ldots,y_k}\prod_{s\in\mathbb F_2^k}f(x+\sum_{i=1}^k s_i y_i)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on $\mathbb F_2^n$
